name: Shuffle
description: Text effect that splits a string into characters and shuffles each one through random glyphs before settling, triggered on scroll into view and on hover, with slide, flip or blur styles.
contents: Single text element (configurable tag) split into per-character cells
behavior: Characters are split with GSAP SplitText and each rolls through random characters before landing on the real one
Plays when the element scrolls into view through ScrollTrigger, once by default
Replays on mouseenter, or with hoverRadius above 0 shuffles only the characters near the pointer
Stagger order set by animationMode: evenodd, center, sequence or random delay
Can loop, tint characters during the roll and call a callback when finished
Skips the animation when the user prefers reduced motion
editableByProps: Text, wrapper tag, alignment, className and inline style
Direction, duration, easing, stagger, roll count, delay and animation order
Scramble character set, text color, start and end colors, accent color for random glyphs
Scroll trigger threshold and margin, trigger once, loop, hover trigger and hover radius
Motion blur and reduced motion handling

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the default font or text size
needsCodeEdit.where: commonStyle fontFamily and the classes template string (text-[4rem])

needsCodeEdit.change: Change blur strength or number of blur levels
Change the flip depth or perspective
needsCodeEdit.where: renderFlip function and the perspective style in build

fixed: Default font is Press Start 2P but the font is not loaded by the component, it must be loaded by the page or overridden with a font- class in className
Text is forced uppercase at 4rem with leading-none unless overridden by className
Registers GSAP ScrollTrigger and SplitText plugins globally
Appends a hidden SVG filter element to document.body when blur is used and removes it on unmount
Element stays invisible until the animation is created, or until reduced motion skips it
Hover local mode listens to pointermove on window
Waits for document fonts to load before building
Fixed text size is large and may wrap on small screens, set a smaller size through className
Effect prop selects the style: slide, flip, or blur, unknown values fall back to slide

options.look: Each character slides like a slot reel through random glyphs inside a clipped cell
options.useWhen: Hero headline that should feel like a retro arcade or slot machine reveal

options.look: Each character flips in 3D around its axis while the glyph changes
options.useWhen: Departure-board style heading or stat label on a tech landing page

options.look: Characters swap glyphs with motion blur and fading while shifting slightly
options.useWhen: Smooth, modern section title where a soft fast scramble fits better than hard clipping
